description_zh: 乔莫·肯雅塔（1889-1978），肯尼亚第一任总理，1963-1978年在任。他是一位肯尼亚部落领袖和政治家，领导肯尼亚独立，从英国殖民统治中解放出来，建立了肯尼亚共和国。他推动了土地分配改革，支持部落政治，奠定了肯尼亚独立的基础。
description_en: Jomo Kenyatta (1889-1978), first Prime Minister of Kenya, served from 1963 to 1978. He was a Kenyan tribal leader and politician who led Kenya to independence from British colonial rule, establishing the Republic of Kenya. He promoted land redistribution reforms and supported tribal politics, laying the foundation for Kenyan independence.
reason_zh: 肯雅塔是肯尼亚独立运动的领导者，通过部落政治和土地改革，建立了肯尼亚国家。他体现了非洲领导者的智慧，通过和平过渡和部落团结实现了国家的独立和统一。
reason_en: Kenyatta was the leader of Kenya's independence movement, establishing the nation through tribal politics and land reforms. He exemplified African leadership wisdom, achieving national independence and unity through peaceful transition and tribal solidarity.
